source_facts: Nacre Forms is a synthetic hosted form-review product. This specification is authoritative for versions 2.8 and 2.9 and every procedure and example on this page. Version 2.9 adds reviewer badges to the Review panel. A badge shows the reviewer's initials, and its tooltip gives the full reviewer name. Badges change presentation only: they do not change review assignments or permissions. Version 2.9 does not rewrite submitted form answers. The optional workspace setting reviewer_badges is initially off after the upgrade. Only a workspace Administrator can install a release or change that setting. In the administration console, Releases provides a version selector and Install action. Selecting 2.9 and choosing Install upgrades the selected workspace only. Installed version reports the completed release version. Feature settings contains reviewer_badges; Save applies a changed setting. New page loads use the saved setting; an already open Review panel must be reloaded. The release exercise uses the separate harbor-preview and harbor-production workspaces. Before upgrading production, the administrator must install 2.9 in harbor-preview and confirm Installed version is 2.9. The preview check uses the existing Enrollment, Renewal, and Closure sample forms; each has one assigned reviewer. Enable reviewer_badges in harbor-preview, save, and reload each sample form's Review panel. Acceptance requires one badge in each of the three panels and a tooltip with that form's assigned reviewer's full name. Record the three form names and pass/fail results in the release ticket. Any failed preview check blocks production installation and goes to Forms Support. A passed preview check permits installing 2.9 in harbor-production. Confirm Installed version is 2.9 before deciding whether to enable production badges. Leaving reviewer_badges off is a supported completion state for the 2.9 release. Production activation is optional and follows the same setting, Save, and reload sequence. Check one existing production form with an assigned reviewer after activation; require the badge initials and full-name tooltip to match the assigned reviewer. A production badge mismatch is handled first by turning reviewer_badges off, saving, and reloading the affected panel; record the observed mismatch and contact Forms Support. Turning off badges keeps version 2.9 installed. If Forms Support directs a version return, first turn reviewer_badges off and save, then select 2.8 in Releases and choose Install. Version 2.8 cannot display reviewer badges. This 2.9-to-2.8 return preserves submitted answers. Confirm Installed version is 2.8 after the return. The release ticket records preview evidence, final production version, and final production reviewer_badges value. No form-answer export or data conversion is required for this release.

# Release Nacre Forms 2.9 to a workspace

This guide is for workspace Administrators upgrading from Nacre Forms 2.8 to 2.9. The release adds optional reviewer badges in the **Review** panel. A badge shows initials, with the reviewer's full name in its tooltip. It changes presentation without changing assignments or permissions. Submitted form answers are not rewritten, and this release requires no answer export or data conversion.

## Prepare the preview check

Use **harbor-preview** before changing **harbor-production**. Only a workspace Administrator can install a release or change `reviewer_badges`. Confirm the selected workspace before using the administration console.

In **Releases**, select **2.9** and choose **Install**. The installation affects only the selected workspace. Continue when **Installed version** reports **2.9**. The `reviewer_badges` setting is initially off, so installing the release does not by itself activate the new display.

## Verify the optional display

In harbor-preview, open **Feature settings**, turn `reviewer_badges` on, and choose **Save**. New page loads use the saved setting. Reload any Review panels that are already open before checking the result.

Use these existing sample forms, each of which has one assigned reviewer:

| Sample form | Required result |
| --- | --- |
| Enrollment | One badge; tooltip gives the assigned reviewer's full name. |
| Renewal | One badge; tooltip gives the assigned reviewer's full name. |
| Closure | One badge; tooltip gives the assigned reviewer's full name. |

Record each form name and its pass/fail result in the release ticket. All three must pass before production installation. If any check fails, stop the release and contact Forms Support with the preview results.

## Install in production

After the preview passes, select **harbor-production**. In **Releases**, install **2.9** and confirm **Installed version** is **2.9**. Then decide whether to activate badges for this workspace.

Leaving `reviewer_badges` off is a supported way to complete the 2.9 release. To activate it, turn the setting on in **Feature settings**, choose **Save**, and reload the Review panel of one existing production form with an assigned reviewer. Check that the badge's initials and full-name tooltip match that reviewer.

If they do not match, first turn `reviewer_badges` off, save, and reload the affected panel. Record the mismatch and contact Forms Support. Disabling the display leaves version 2.9 installed, so record the feature setting separately from the release version.

## Return to 2.8 when directed

If Forms Support directs a version return, turn `reviewer_badges` off and save before selecting **2.8** in **Releases** and choosing **Install**. Confirm **Installed version** reports **2.8** afterward.

Version 2.8 cannot display reviewer badges. The documented return from 2.9 preserves submitted answers; no answer conversion is part of this path.

Close the release ticket with the preview evidence, the final production version, and the final production `reviewer_badges` value. These entries distinguish a completed upgrade with badges off, an activated display, and a version return.
